title: FIT TO RUN 2026 Leg 3 Review: SMOKE10's Clark Parade Grounds Marathon
seo_title: FIT TO RUN 2026 Leg 3 Review | Clark Pampanga Philippines
meta_description: FIT TO RUN 2026 Leg 3: November 8 at Clark Parade Grounds, Pampanga. Full marathon to 5K from SMOKE10 Events. Registration pending.
dek: Set for 8 November 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds, this SMOKE10 Events production offers four distances from 5K to full marathon. A Clark-based Philippine race on wide, fast roads.
verdict: FIT TO RUN 2026 Leg 3 is a SMOKE10 Events production at Clark Parade Grounds — one of the Philippines' best running venues. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) and Clark's wide, flat, traffic-free roads make it a PB-friendly setup. Registration isn't open yet and the reliability score is low, so it's primarily for Clark/Pampanga-based runners to track. The November date in Pampanga is dry-season onset, with comfortable morning temperatures.
